  "content": "&#96;&#96;&#96;cpp\nswapRoom3TextBlocks(byte *textData, size_t textSize) {\n\t// Room 3 has special text data reordering logic in the DOS version\n\t// Find the '-' character that marks the swap point\n\tbyte *textScanner = textData;\n\tsize_t pos = 0;\n\t\n\t// Search for '-' character (0x2D)\n\twhile (pos &lt; textSize &amp;&amp; *textScanner != '-') {\n\t\ttextScanner++;\n\t\tpos++;\n\t}\n\t\n\tif (pos &gt;= textSize) {\n\t\tdebug(\"Room 3: Could not find '-' character for text swap\");\n\t\treturn;\n\t}\n\t\n\t// Swap text blocks using a temporary buffer\n\t// Original DOS code:\n\t// memcpy(text_scanner + 0x4e22, text_scanner + 2, 0x474);\n\t// memcpy(text_scanner + 10, text_scanner + 0x4e22, 0x474);\n\t\n\tconst size_t blockSize = 0x474;\n\tconst size_t tempOffset = 0x4e22;\n\tconst size_t sourceOffset = 2;\n\tconst size_t destOffset = 10;\n\t\n\t// Check bounds\n\tif (pos + tempOffset + blockSize &gt; textSize || \n\t    pos + sourceOffset + blockSize &gt; textSize ||\n\t    pos + destOffset + blockSize &gt; textSize) {\n\t\tdebug(\"Room 3: Text swap would exceed buffer bounds, skipping\");\n\t\treturn;\n\t}\n\t\n\t// Allocate temporary buffer for the swap\n\tbyte *tempBlock = new byte[blockSize];\n\t\n\t// Copy block from (scanner + 2) to temporary location (scanner + 0x4e22)\n\tCommon::copy(textScanner + sourceOffset, \n\t            textScanner + sourceOffset + blockSize, \n\t            tempBlock);\n\t\n\t// Copy from temp location back to (scanner + 10)\n\tCommon::copy(tempBlock, tempBlock + blockSize, textScanner + destOffset);\n\t\n\tdelete[] tempBlock;\n\t\n\tdebug(\"Room 3: Text blocks swapped successfully\");\n}\n\nvoid RoomManager::\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n",
